1.21.1.0.2022.0:
# Copper Age

![Copper Age](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/copper-age.gif)

Copper has arrived on the train. Copper gear, spears, and the new Dappled Forest.
You'll also find a new series of underwater dimensional carriages, bigger and improved chunk dimensions and a new market carriage. Backpacks now open in workstations, and some performance optimisations (with more to come).

- **Copper gear.** Copper armour, tools and weapons now sit between stone and iron. You'll find them in chests, and your enemies will be wearing them.
- **Spears.** Every tier, from wooden to netherite. They turn up wherever swords do, in chests and in the hands of the things trying to stop you.
- **A longer climb.** With copper in the mix, iron, diamond and netherite gear arrive a little later on the train.
- **A new wood**, with a train stage of its own, plus a host of new blocks to find.

**Performance ×7 · New Feature ×2 · Editor ×2 · Train ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.2021.0

**Smoother fights on long trains**

Echoes and digging mobs take less work to run, so busy carriages stay smoother as the train grows.

**Editor: slimmer villager job toggle**

In the editor, the villager job toggle on block variant rows is now a slim one-letter button.

- Editor: the villager job toggle is a slim one-letter button

### 0.2017.0

**Lighter mob ticks**

Mobs and players spend a little less time each tick on enchantment bookkeeping.

**A new room to find**

A new room to discover as you ride.

- A new room to discover as you ride
- Editor: villagers in block variants can take the nearest job, a random job, or be nitwits
- Editor: the Solid condition no longer counts slabs and stairs

**Performance improvement**

Some rooms you reach from the train are now prepared while you are still on your way, so they are ready when you arrive, and the game keeps less of them in memory.

### 0.2015.0

**Lighter mob thinking during fights**

Mobs that can dig spend less effort deciding whether to dig while they fight you from range.

**Smaller saves runs lighter**

With Smaller saves on, the game no longer rechecks all the untouched terrain around you many times a second, so the option stops costing time while you ride.

### 0.2014.0

**Backpack beside one more smelter**

Your backpack now also opens beside one more smelter, so you can feed it and collect from it straight from your backpack.

### 0.2011.0

**Performance improvement**

A few small jobs that ran all the time now skip themselves when there is nothing to do, so the game does a little less work every tick and every time you hover an item.

**Performance tweak**

Some screens in the world now cost almost nothing to draw while you are not looking at them.

Your backpack now also opens beside enchanting tables, grindstones, stonecutters, looms, cartography tables, brewing stands, crafters, dispensers and droppers, so you can feed them straight from it.

**Dimensional carriages under the sea**

Some dimensional carriages now open under the sea.

- Builders get a Forced Air block and can waterlog block variants with a water bucket.

### 0.2009.0

**Update photos load faster on the website**

Photos on the website's update cards and Updates page now come from a faster image host.

### 0.2008.0

**Better lag diagnostics**

When the game hitches for a second or so, the log now records what was running, so lag reports can be traced to their cause.

**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.2007.0

**Backpack at your workstations**

Your backpack now opens beside crafting tables, furnaces, anvils, smithing tables and hoppers. Shift-clicking moves things between them, and what you make can stack straight into your backpack.
1.21.1.0.2006.0:
**New Feature ×5 · Community ×3 · New Content ×2 · Train ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Balance ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Editor ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.2006.0

**No more crash on respawn with mismatched ragdoll mods**

If your Sable: Ragdolls and Sable: Ragdoll - Patch versions don't match, dying and boarding again no longer crashes the game. Death bodies just switch off until the two match again.

### 0.2003.0

**Skilled echoes hit and run**

The best melee fighters among echoes now fight like skilled players: they step in to strike when their swing is ready, then back out of your reach while it recharges. Clumsy fighters still stand and trade blows.

- Echoes no longer stumble forward or slide sideways off the train when backing away.

### 0.2001.0

**HD Streams**

HD Streams can now be given: a month of sharper 1080p Live Eye streams for everyone.

- While HD Streams is on, streams go out at 1080p instead of 720p
- A smaller stream size you picked yourself is kept, and a slow upload stays at 720p so it never stalls

**Voice on Stream is on for everyone**

Voice on Stream now shows as ON in Community Rewards, paid for by the dev, so there is nothing to give for it.

**New looks for the wide rooms**

The wide rooms now come dressed in a few different styles.

- The wide rooms come in new styles
- Editor: frames can be as wide as the room they dress

### 0.1999.0

**Echoes fight from reach distance**

Echoes now swing from a player's reach instead of pushing right up against you. Skilled fighters keep near the edge of their reach; clumsy ones crowd in close.

- A crowded skilled fighter steps back, but never off the train.
- If you duck behind a wall, they walk around it to get back in reach.

**A wider room to find**

A new, much wider room to discover as you ride.

- A wide new room to discover as you ride

### 0.1998.0

**Safer photos in Kid mode**

Photos that someone has reported no longer turn up in Kid mode.

A new room to discover as you ride.

Found a photo that shouldn't be on the train? A faint warning icon next to Close lets you report it and say why.

More varied names in more languages.

### 0.1992.0

**Some mobs carry better gear**

Now and then a monster on the train carries gear far better than its neighbours', close to what you'd find in a chest, and it drops that gear much more often.

### 0.1991.0

**Mobs leave carpet and doors alone**

Mobs that dig their way to you no longer tear up carpet they could step over or doors they could walk through. They open wooden doors like you would, and only break a carpet when it is really what stops them getting through.
1.21.1.0.1990.0:
**New Feature ×6 · Menus & UI ×6 · Bug Fix ×5 · Editor ×4 · Train ×3 · New Content ×1 · Community ×1 · Loot ×1 · Advancements ×1**

### 0.1990.0

**New rooms and a chest loot fix**

A handful of new rooms built by the community join the train, and chests in several existing rooms now hold fresh loot each time instead of always the same items.

- New rooms from community builders
- Chests in several rooms now roll their loot

### 0.1987.0

**Drifting engines show their home world**

Open a Drifting Engine Block and it now tells you whose world it came from, right under the carriage id. Engines you place say they are from your world, wherever they travel.

**Lock signs together in block variants**

Builders can now lock all the signs in a block variant cell to one sign's settings.

- Click the lock on a sign and every other sign in the cell copies its mount, facing, text, colour, glow and wax, keeping its own wood
- While locked, a change to any of them reaches them all, and new signs added to the cell join in
- Wax and text editing are now quick icon buttons at the top of the sign popup

### 0.1986.0

**Death camera flies to your killer**

After you die, the camera now flies through the world from your body to whoever killed you, and back again, instead of cutting through black.

- A shorter look at the mob that killed you
- The flight back carries straight on into the next shot

### 0.1984.0

**Redstone ore fix**

Glowing redstone ore in dimensional carriages now fades back to normal over time, the same as everywhere else.

**Lighting and sky fix**

Lighting and sky fix.

### 0.1982.0

**Half hearts show as half hearts**

Gaining half a heart of max health now shows half a heart on your health bar, instead of a whole empty one you could never fill.

**Flower pot fix**

Potted plants in carriages now match how far the train has travelled.

### 0.1981.0

**Editor: still water and separate test settings**

Water and lava you place while building in the editor now stay put instead of flooding the plot, and saved builds keep only the source blocks you placed. Editor settings like Redstone, TNT and Mobs now remember a separate choice for when you test a carriage.

- New Fluid flow setting in the editor: off while you build, on when you test
- Saved builds no longer bake in half-spread water or lava
- Redstone, TNT, Observers, Auto fly, Mobs and Fluid flow each keep their own setting inside Test the Carriage

### 0.1980.0

**Editor: rooms that play in order**

In the editor, a room's sub-variants can now be set to appear in a set order, to show up only once for each player, or to get rarer or commoner after a player has seen them a few times.

- Order: pick which sub-variant comes first, second and so on
- Seen again: let a sub-variant appear just once per player
- After visits: change how often it appears once a player has been there enough times

**Signs in block variants**

Builders can now add signs as block variant options in the editor, give them text, and pick how they hang.

- A sign can be one of a cell's block options, with its own text or one text shared by every sign in the cell
- Choose how it is mounted: on a wall, standing, hanging, on a wall bracket, or Auto to fit whatever is around it
- Write the front and back, pick a text colour and glow, and wax it so passengers can't change it

### 0.1979.0

**Advancement fix**

Advancements are no longer earned while you lie dead waiting to respawn.

Your going-live message now leaves out any of Twitch, YouTube or Kick that the stream isn't going to right now, so nobody gets sent to an empty channel. If you turned on restreaming to your own Twitch channel, Options and /twitch now say when that restream is paused.
1.21.1.0.1974.0:

**Seasonal carriages**

Some carriages now only turn up around festivals from around the world. Keep an eye out at Christmas, Halloween, Diwali, Lunar New Year and more.

**Wall and fence styles in dimensional carriages**

Walls, fences, panes and bars in dimensional carriage builds can now join up or keep a fixed shape, just like in carriages.

In the block variant menu, right-click a group entry to open that group's options right above, and change them without losing your place.

New places to explore in dimensional carriages, and a new kind of enemy carriage.

Every Community Reward now shows how much of your gift reaches the developer once it has paid its own running costs and card fees.

**Faster block variant conditions**

Setting conditions on block variants in the editor takes fewer clicks, and you can see what each one is checking.

### 0.1964.0

**Room fixes**

A few rooms fit together and look a little better.

**World Border fix**

The world border no longer stands across the doorways of its carriages.

### 0.1963.0

**New rooms and carriage finds**

Four new rooms can now turn up behind dimensional carriage doors, two of them built by Nikeeta, and an old favourite has been reworked. Carriages have new things in them too, from suits of armour to beds piled with books.

- Four new rooms to discover as you ride

- New things to find inside carriages

Your own Discord webhooks can now get your passenger log too: your deaths, milestones and stories. Give each link a name, and pick what each one gets: Tributes, your passenger log, or both.

In the block variant editor, a Rot Free group can now be added to another cell several times, each copy facing a different way. Each row shows the block turned to its facing.

Some dimensional carriages are now edged by a shimmering world border. Step through it and it turns red, and the space beyond is yours to build in.

### 0.1958.0

**Block variant groups share their Copies setting**

In the editor, changing where a grouped block variant applies (the room, its copies, or both) now changes it for every block in the group, not just the one you clicked.

In a block variant group with free rotation, a block you add now faces the same way as the blocks already in each cell, instead of copying the cell you clicked.

Your backpack now opens beside the trade screen, and trades can be paid straight from it.

After you die, the world behind the menu goes quiet: no more mobs, rain or wind playing on while you choose what comes next. The sound fades back in when you arrive.

### 0.1949.0

Two advancements could unlock on their own right after boarding a new run. They now wait until you earn them.
1.21.1.0.1950.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1 · Balance ×1**

### 0.1949.0

**Cameras and backpacks are a little rarer**

Instant cameras and edible backpacks now turn up about a fifth less often in chests, pots, vases and vaults.

### 0.1948.0

**Shulker box fix**

Zombie hands can no longer open a shulker box from your hotbar.

### 0.1946.0

**Tell us what happened when the game freezes**

When the game asks to send a log after a freeze, there's now a Yes with info button. It opens the bug report with Lag already picked, so you can add what you were doing when it froze, and it's sent along with your logs.
1.21.1.0.1945.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Editor ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1945.0

**Editor quick toggles tidy-up and auto fly**

The editor's quick toggles are now a compact row of icons beside Settings. Turning the frame off no longer drops you out of your build, and a new Auto fly setting (on by default) catches you if you fall below the editor plots.
1.21.1.0.1944.0:
**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1944.0

**Record your deaths as videos**

A new option saves each death as a video: the 8 seconds before you died and the whole death scene, with game sound. Turn on Record Deaths in Options, General. It is off by default, since it keeps recording in the background while you play.

- Your death also replays behind the death screen
- Videos are saved to the dungeontrain/death-videos folder; click the file name in chat to watch
1.21.1.0.1943.0:
**Editor ×3 · Community ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Performance ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1942.0

**Shared build fix**

Builds still saved on your computer that went missing from your profile now come back too, not only the ones kept in backups.

### 0.1940.0

**Community photos use much less data**

Community photos found on the train now download far less in the background. A game only fetches the photos it has room for, and fetches none while nobody is playing.

### 0.1939.0

**Shared build fix**

Your shared builds no longer show up twice in your profile.

- Builds put back after a lost upload now land on their existing entry instead of making a copy.
- Put-back builds upload at their real size, not several times larger.
- Saving a new build twice in quick succession makes one entry, not two.

**Quick toggles in the editor menu**

A small arrow beside Settings in the editor's X menu opens three one-click toggles, so you can switch common editor options without leaving the page you're on.

- Mirror: pause mirroring for every template at once. Each template keeps its own mirror axes for when you turn it back on.
- Menus: hide or show the floating editor menus; turning them back on returns to the mode you had.
- Frame: show or hide the carriage around Contents builds, so you can see and reach your build from every side. Also in Settings.
1.21.1.0.1938.0:

### 0.1937.0

**Trash slot tooltip fix**

The trash slot's tooltip no longer has item durability bars drawn over its text.

### 0.1935.0

**Builder menu fix**

Loading a very large shared build no longer stops to ask first, and its preview now says "No preview" instead of "Oversized".

**Death cinematic plays out**

Your first death now plays its cinematic all the way through, and every later one gives it a few seconds before you can skip.

- The first death's cinematic can't be skipped
- Skipping waits a few seconds after every death
- Change the view with the arrow keys; movement keys no longer cut the scene

### 0.1933.0

**Advancement fix**

Fixed an advancement that could be awarded without doing it.
1.21.1.0.1932.0:
# Go Out in Style

**Startup crash fix**

The game no longer crashes at startup when another installed mod has trouble loading. It now recovers to the title screen.

### 0.1930.0

**Testing tools improvement**

Behind-the-scenes work on the tools used to test Dungeon Train. Nothing changes in game.

**Skeletons and evokers fight properly on the train**

Skeletons on the train now keep their distance and shoot from across the carriage instead of walking up to you, and evokers' fangs now rise from the carriage floor.

**Cracked blocks break faster**

Cracked blocks, like cracked stone bricks and cracked nether bricks, now break a little faster than their whole versions.
1.21.1.0.1926.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Mobs ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1926.0

**Named monsters**

Now and then a monster on the train has a name over its head.

### 0.1924.0

**Click the Stream preview to change what viewers see**

On the Options Stream tab, click the HUD, chat, name or pinned live feed in the preview to show or hide it for viewers. Hover a part to see what a click does. The new Preview setting puts the preview pinned below the settings, above or under the list, or turns it off.

### 0.1924.0

**Block variant groups can rotate freely**

Block variant groups in the train editor can now let each block face its own way while still sharing the same block, and there's a new carriage room to discover.

- Editor: a Rot Lock / Rot Free switch on block variant groups. Rot Free gives every block in the group its own facing and flip.

### 0.1921.0

**AI Policy update**

New system to keep the AI Policy consistent with the website.

**Java safety check on CurseForge**

On CurseForge, MC Java Safety Check now installs as its own mod alongside Dungeon Train, so its page gets the credit. Nothing changes in game.

### 0.1919.0

**More varied mob names**

Creatures more often get made-up names, and a few more are named after their kind or colour. Now and then a made-up name starts with a vowel.
